tasks.description: Indexes the files of a project tree by extension with counts and sizes. Use when asked for a file index of a project grouped by extension.
tasks.intent: Index project files by extension with counts and sizes.

tasks.description: Reports the files of a project tree that are larger than 2 KiB, largest first. Use when asked for a large-file report of a project.
tasks.intent: Report project files larger than 2 KiB.

tasks.description: Checks file names in a project tree against a lowercase naming convention and suggests replacements. Use when asked for a naming-convention check of a project's files.
tasks.intent: Report file names that break the naming convention, with suggested names.
